A squat brass contraption of horns, pins and a slowly turning drum, salvaged from somewhere that does not exist yet.

Activate it to choose a tune. The music fills the area you are standing in and plays on a loop until you pick another or switch it off. It does not travel with you -- walk away and it keeps playing to the empty room, and you must come back here to change it.

It plays on the music channel, so the Music slider in your sound options is the volume knob.
